name: SAP

Software Engineer (India).dsaDepth: Moderate — an OA with role-based MCQs and coding, then 2 technical rounds and an HR round
rounds: Online assessment: role-based MCQs plus coding questions
Technical Round 1: core CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms), sometimes live coding or a system-design question depending on experience
Technical Round 2: deeper project/experience discussion, advanced problem-solving, role-specific tech stack, often with senior engineers/team leads
HR round: cultural fit and offer discussion
extraTopics: OOP fundamentals and their practical implementation
SQL and ER-diagram design for some pipelines
Software Engineer (India).notes: Some India (Bengaluru) reports describe a shorter 3-4 round same-day process; a few older/other-location reports describe 5 rounds (written, 2 technical, managerial, HR). Difficulty is generally rated easy-to-moderate.
